messages.author: 428590d44d600401
messages.subject: Grey scale
parts:
Hi all,

I'd like to create error bar plot for a factor with two levels, in
grey scale. The default using scale_colour_grey() works, and the
black error bars look great, but the light grey error bars are almost
too pale to see against the grey background of the plot. I realize
this is a very basic question, but - does anyone know how to change
the default grey scale such that my two factor levels can be in black
and dark grey instead? The documentation suggests that there is a way
to turn off the light grey colour, but I think the documentation may
be incomplete, as it shows an error:

> # You may want to turn off the pale grey background with this scale
> p + scale_colour_grey() + theme_bw
Error: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable



Thank you!

Tonya
